description: The Breeze bridge contract. The page calls actions through window.breezeQuery (a JCEF message router); Java answers each one exactly once. Java pushes events through window.__breezeEvent. Both the TypeScript client (frontend/src/bridge) and the Java router (common/src/main/java/dev/breeze/bridge) are tested against this file.

app.hello.summary: Protocol version, mod and Minecraft versions, context (title or in-game), feature availability.

app.openExternal.summary: Open an allow-listed https link in the system browser. Never navigates the embedded browser.

ui.close.summary: Close the Breeze screen, if the current context allows closing.

ui.escapeAck.summary: The page answers a key.escape event. handled=false means it was already at the root.

ui.route.summary: The page reports its route so a reopened screen starts where the player left.

ui.vanillaMenu.summary: Show the vanilla title screen for the rest of this session.

ui.menuStyle.summary: Choose which Breeze menu opens from now on, saved: web (this menu) or classic (the game's own screens and Minecraft's title screen). Classic closes this menu.

ui.reportError.summary: The page hit an error; Java writes it to the game log.

game.state.summary: Player, world and connection facts read on the client thread.

game.joinServer.summary: Connect to a server the player has joined before.

game.pauseMenu.summary: Open Minecraft's own game menu while in a world.

game.quit.summary: Quit Minecraft. The page confirms first.

settings.get.summary: Breeze interface settings, stored locally on this computer.

settings.set.summary: Change one interface setting. Answers with the full settings.

settings.reset.summary: Restore every interface setting to its default.

modules.list.summary: Every Breeze module with its category, state and settings.

modules.icons.summary: Each module's Minecraft icon, read from the game's own textures: the PNG as data and the square of it to show.

modules.setEnabled.summary: Turn a module on or off.

modules.reset.summary: Restore one module's settings to their defaults.

hud.openEditor.summary: Open the HUD editor, which moves the real HUD.

music.open.summary: Open the Music player (Spotify) over this menu; closing it returns here.

mods.list.summary: Mods Fabric actually loaded in this game, each marked breeze, game, library or mod.

integrations.list.summary: What Breeze can open from other mods (Mod Menu's list and each mod's settings screen, mods' own "breeze" entrypoints, at the title the buttons mods put on the title screen), each action with the mod it belongs to where Java can tell (the menu shows one row per mod), and integrations that failed.

integrations.open.summary: Open an integration's screen over the Breeze menu; closing it returns there.

keys.list.summary: Breeze's key bindings (the menu, music, every module): each key, its default, and the other bindings on the same key. The same bindings Minecraft's Controls shows.

keys.capture.summary: The next key pressed in the Breeze menu becomes this binding (Escape cancels); the page hears keys.changed and never sees that key.

keys.reset.summary: Put a binding back on its default key, or on no key. Returns keys.list.

commandKeys.list.summary: The player's command keys: each command, its key (with Ctrl, Shift or Alt if set), whether it is on, the other bindings on the same key, and in a world whether the server offers the command.

commandKeys.save.summary: Add a command key (no id) or change one's command or on/off. The command is checked (one line, no formatting codes, at most 255 characters); refused with the reason (INVALID). Returns commandKeys.list.

commandKeys.remove.summary: Remove a command key. Returns commandKeys.list.

commandKeys.capture.summary: The next key pressed in the Breeze menu, with the Ctrl, Shift or Alt held with it, becomes this command key's (Escape cancels). A key Minecraft needs for moving, jumping, sneaking, sprinting, attacking, using, the inventory or chat is refused unless Ctrl, Shift or Alt is held with it. The page hears commandKeys.changed.

commandKeys.unbind.summary: Take a command key's key away; the command stays. Returns commandKeys.list.

packs.list.summary: The resource packs Minecraft knows: each pack's id, title, description, picture (data: URI or null), whether it suits this version, whether it is required or keeps a fixed place, and whether it is on; the ones on, top first (the top one wins). Read from Minecraft's own pack list.

packs.apply.summary: Turn on these packs, top first, and the rest off, through Minecraft's own options (saved; resources reload only when the list changed). Required packs stay on and fixed ones keep their place; ids the game does not know are left out. Returns packs.list with reloading.

packs.openFolder.summary: Open Minecraft's resourcepacks folder in the system's file manager.

crosshair.export.summary: The Custom Crosshair's settings as a share code (contract/crosshair.json): { code }.

crosshair.import.summary: Take a share code's crosshair settings, and nothing else. Refused with the reason (INVALID) when the code is damaged, foreign or from a newer Breeze. Returns the module.

account.get.summary: The Minecraft profile and the state of the Breeze sign-in the launcher handed over.

cosmetics.state.summary: Owned and equipped capes, and the 3D cosmetics the account wears, from the Breeze API.

cosmetics.equipCape.summary: Equip an owned cape, or unequip with no id.

cosmetics.equipModel.summary: Equip an owned 3D cosmetic in its slot.

friends.list.summary: Friends and requests, from the last poll of the Breeze API.

friends.request.summary: Send a friend request by Minecraft name.

friends.respond.summary: Accept or decline a friend request.

hosting.state.summary: Whether this world is being hosted, whether it could be, and invites from friends.

hosting.start.summary: Open the current singleplayer world to friends through the Breeze relay.

hosting.stop.summary: Stop hosting and close the relay session.

hosting.join.summary: Join a friend's hosted world from an invite.

events.key.escape: Escape was pressed in game. The page must answer with ui.escapeAck within 500 ms.
events.settings.changed: Interface settings changed. Payload: the full settings.
events.modules.changed: A module changed outside the page, for example by its keybind. Payload: { name }.
events.game.changed: The player joined or left a world. Payload: game.state.
events.window.resized: The game window changed size. Payload: { width, height, scale }.
events.keys.changed: A key the page asked for (keys.capture) was pressed. Payload: { id, cancelled }; the page reads keys.list again.
events.commandKeys.changed: A key the page asked for (commandKeys.capture) was pressed. Payload: { id, cancelled, refused? } (refused: why the key was not taken); the page reads commandKeys.list again.
